title: Guest Stays under Community Rules & Site Care
content:
Guests staying at a home site are governed by these Community Rules & Site Care provisions:

- A guest staying more than the plan's guest registration threshold, in consecutive days, must be registered by the resident, without charge.
- A registered guest may stay no more than the plan's maximum number of consecutive days. A guest who will stay longer must apply and be screened as an occupant on the lease, and until approved the stay beyond that limit is an occupancy violation handled by the community manager.
- A guest is never charged an occupant charge while registered as a guest.

## Stay lengths compared

Hypothetical stays, taking the 7-day registration threshold and the 30-day maximum the parking and guest schedule shows for every plan:

| Consecutive days of the stay | Registration | Position |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | not required | ordinary guest stay |
| 8 | required, without charge | registered guest |
| 30 | required, without charge | registered guest, at the maximum |
| 31 | required | beyond the maximum: the guest must apply and be screened as an occupant; until approved, the stay beyond 30 days is an occupancy violation for the community manager |

## Points of judgement

- Registration carries no charge, and a registered guest carries no occupant charge.
- The occupancy violation for a stay beyond the maximum is handled by the community manager, not through the resident desk's charges.
